QuestInfo.name: Luden's Warning 1
QuestInfo.0: #p2161002# seems to have some words of wisdom he'd like to share with you. Whatever he has to say may help you in your future battles. It should be worth a listen.
QuestInfo.1: To learn what #p2161002# wants to teach you, you must have #rat least 1 Lion King's Weapon Scroll#k from #r#t2430558##k. Defeating #o8210013# at Ani's Jail is the only way to get one.
QuestInfo.2: #p2161002# taught you how to obtain a better weapon using this scroll.

0.0: There are many ways a warrior like yourself can become stronger, but some of them may not be known to you!\r\n#L0##bReally? I'm pretty sure I got this all figured out...#l\n#k
0.1: You believe so, do you? Then you must do something to prove that you still have room to learn. What do you say?

yes.0: Good choice. First, obtain #rat least one Lion King's Weapon Scroll#k from #o8210013#. If you survive, come and see me.

no.0: Talk to me again when you're prepared. You must be strong enough to face our king!

1.0: Well done! That scroll was given out to honored knights before our king turned into... It is a shame to see them in those monsters' hands.
1.1: I apologize. An old man gets caught up thinking of the past sometimes. You may take that Lion King's Weapon Scroll you got and #rapply it to your equipment for a 70% chance of upgrade#k. Give it a shot if you're curious!
1.2: Many weapon scrolls exist throughout Maple World. Just remember, #rusing these scrolls comes with a risk of destroying the weapon you are attempting to enhance#k. It is important to consider the possible consequences. But do not worry for now. The Lion King's Weapon Scroll will not destroy your weapon, even should it fail.
1.3: Finally, #ravailable equipment upgrade counts are displayed in an item's details#k. Items can only be upgraded a limited number of times, so pay close attention to the scrolls you receive before you go willy-nilly with the upgrading.

yes.0: I've told you everything you need to know about the weapon scroll. I truly hope that you get your hands on a powerful weapon to help you stop the fallen king.

default.0: You haven't gotten the #rLion King's Weapon Scroll#k from #rAni's Box#k yet. No rush. You'll get one eventually...
